title: Qui-Gon Jinn
description: Qui-Gon Jinn was a venerable Jedi Knight and a maverick of the Order, often bucking the advice of the Jedi Council. When he encountered the young slave boy Anakin Skywalker, he earned the boy's freedom and vowed to train him - even against the wishes of the council. Before he could train him, he was cut down by the Sith Lord Darth Maul, leaving Anakin's fate in the balance.
